description: This plot illustrates the relationship between the Recent Sequence Ratio (%) and two distinct metrics: Perplexity and GPU Memory Ratio (%). The x-axis is labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)" and features a linear scale with visible tick marks at intervals of 20, ranging from 20 to 100. The plot utilizes dual y-axes; the left y-axis is labeled "Perplexity" with a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7 and tick marks every 0.1, while the right y-axis is labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)" with a linear scale showing tick marks from 40 to 90 at intervals of 10. Four lines are displayed on the graph. The "Perplexity" data, corresponding to the left y-axis, is shown as a solid orange line with circular markers. It begins at a high of approximately 4.6 at an x-value of 10, declines to a minimum of 4.35 at x=40, fluctuates slightly before dropping to 4.38 at x=70, and then rises to end at 4.5 at x=100. The "Full Cache PPL" baseline, also on the left y-axis, is a dashed red line that slopes upward from approximately 4.39 at x=10 to 4.5 at x=100. The "GPU Mem. Ratio" data, corresponding to the right y-axis, is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers. It starts at roughly 25% at x=10, increases steadily to about 43% at x=70, rises to 50% at x=80, and then experiences a sharp spike to approximately 95% at x=90, concluding at 100% at x=100. Finally, the "Full Cache GPU Mem." baseline is depicted as a dashed blue line on the right y-axis, remaining constant at a steady trend of approximately 98% across the entire plotted x-axis range.
